skill.name: free-tool-strategy
skill.description: Plan and evaluate free tools that attract organic traffic, generate qualified leads, and create a natural path to your core product.
skill.summary: Create an evidence-based strategy for a focused, useful, and measurable free tool.

content.user_title: Plan a Free Tool That Generates Qualified Leads
content.value_statement: Free tools can waste development effort when audience fit, distribution, and conversion paths are unclear. This skill creates a focused strategy for validation, launch, and measurement.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates tool ideas across audience fit, search demand, uniqueness, product alignment, build feasibility, maintenance, links, and sharing potential.
Suggests focused concepts such as calculators, generators, analyzers, validators, resource libraries, and interactive educational tools.
Defines an MVP scope, build approach, lead capture model, follow-up path, and phased timeline.
Plans SEO, outreach, launch channels, product integration, and ongoing promotion.
Creates acquisition, engagement, conversion, attribution, and ROI measurement frameworks.
limitations: It does not verify live keyword volumes, competitor performance, or current market demand.
It does not build, host, test, or maintain the proposed tool.
ROI projections depend on accurate traffic, conversion, cost, and customer value inputs.
Lead capture plans require separate privacy, consent, accessibility, and legal review.

use_cases.title: Validate a SaaS Calculator
use_cases.description: Score an ROI calculator, define its MVP, and connect results to a relevant product journey.

use_cases.title: Package Agency Expertise
use_cases.description: Turn a repeated discovery process into a useful assessment or estimator that attracts suitable prospects.

use_cases.title: Grow Developer Awareness
use_cases.description: Plan a validator, playground, or reference library that earns search traffic and demonstrates technical expertise.

prompt_templates.title: Assess One Tool Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this free tool idea: [idea]. My business is [business], and my audience is [audience]. Identify strengths, risks, and the next validation step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you have an early idea and need a quick structured assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Focused Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate five free tool concepts for [business]. Target [audience] and their problem with [problem]. Compare utility, product fit, search potential, and build effort.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you know the audience problem but have not selected a tool type.

prompt_templates.title: Design an MVP Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an MVP strategy for [tool]. Include core inputs, outputs, build approach, lead capture, follow-up, SEO content, launch channels, metrics, and a phased timeline.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after validating a concept and before committing development resources.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Investment Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [idea A], [idea B], and [idea C] for [business]. Score every framework factor. State assumptions, projected ROI, key risks, and a final recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced portfolio decision with several competing concepts.

output_examples.input: Evaluate an ROI calculator for a workflow automation platform serving operations managers.
output: Recommendation: Proceed with validation because the concept has clear product alignment and personalized value.
MVP: Compare current manual hours, labor cost, automation coverage, and estimated annual savings.
Lead capture: Show the savings range, then offer an emailed calculation summary.
Primary metrics: Calculator completion rate, qualified capture rate, product visits, and influenced pipeline.

output_examples.input: Suggest a free tool for a cybersecurity consulting agency targeting small software companies.
output: Concept: A security readiness assessment with prioritized next steps.
Audience fit: Engineering leaders need a simple way to identify gaps before procurement or audits.
Build approach: Start with a short rules-based questionnaire and a clear results page.
Boundary: Avoid presenting the assessment as a penetration test or compliance certification.

output_examples.input: Compare a template library with a project cost estimator for a design agency.
output: The estimator offers stronger lead qualification and a clearer path to an agency consultation.
The library may earn broader search traffic but will likely capture lower-intent visitors.
Validate the estimator first using historical project ranges and a simple landing page.

best_practices: Provide real standalone value before asking users for contact information.
Validate audience demand and product alignment before estimating build scope.
Define acquisition, completion, lead quality, and revenue metrics before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not build a complex tool before testing the problem and distribution plan.
Do not require account creation when a simpler capture method supports the goal.
Do not use inflated ROI assumptions or hide important calculation limits.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide your product, target audience, audience problem, goal, technical capacity, timeline, budget, and current lead generation approach.

faq.question: Can this skill choose the best tool type?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare calculators, generators, analyzers, validators, libraries, and educational tools against your audience problem.

faq.question: Does this skill conduct keyword research?
faq.answer: It can define keyword themes and evaluation criteria. It cannot access verified search volume or ranking data without external research.

faq.question: Will it create an implementation plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline MVP features, build options, lead capture, promotion, metrics, and phases. It does not produce the finished tool.

faq.question: Can I plan an entirely ungated tool?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports ungated, optionally captured, partially gated, and fully gated models based on value, reach, and conversion goals.

faq.question: How does it estimate ROI?
faq.answer: It combines estimated leads, customer conversion, customer value, build cost, and maintenance cost. Results remain projections, not guarantees.
